label: Reviewer Guidelines
description: Reviewer hero, review protocol, ethics, rubrics and recognition.

hero.label: Hero Banner
hero.description: Eyebrow, headline, intro, highlights, CTAs and the reviewer specifications card. Spec tone: default, mono, accent or success.
hero.title: Reviewer Responsibilities & Evaluation Framework
hero.subtitle: PEER REVIEW STANDARDS
hero.content: Independent peer reviewers are the cornerstone of scholarly integrity at the **Gono Bishwabidyalay Journal of Research**. Our reviewers provide constructive, impartial, and evidence-grounded assessments under strict double-blind confidentiality.

meta.noteText: Reviewers must declare any potential competing interest prior to accessing manuscript files. Unpublished material cannot be cited or reused.

covenant.label: Reviewer Covenant
covenant.description: Six reviewer commitments: heading, intro and principle cards
covenant.title: Six Commitments Behind Every Peer Appraisal
covenant.subtitle: REVIEWER COVENANT
covenant.content: Reviewers safeguard unpublished science, assess evidence objectively, and deliver constructive feedback to advance scholarly discovery.

principles.title: Availability & Conflict Check
principles.subtitle: Pre-Review Declaration
principles.description: Reviewers must confirm subject-matter expertise, absence of institutional or personal conflicts of interest, and availability to complete the review by the agreed deadline before manuscript files are unlocked.

principles.title: Methodological Soundness
principles.subtitle: Scientific Rigor
principles.description: Evaluate research hypotheses, experimental controls, data reproducibility, sampling validity, and statistical analysis against discipline-specific international standards.

principles.title: Absolute Confidentiality
principles.subtitle: Privileged Information
principles.description: Manuscripts under review are privileged academic property. Reviewers must never distribute, quote, upload to generative AI, or appropriate unpublished concepts or data.

principles.title: Objective Conflict Disclosure
principles.subtitle: Unbiased Appraisal
principles.description: If a reviewer discovers the identity of the author during assessment or realizes a competing professional connection, they must immediately notify the editor and recuse themselves.

principles.title: Constructive & Actionable Feedback
principles.subtitle: Scholarly Mentorship
principles.description: Review reports must be clear, respectful, and evidence-supported. Critique should pinpoint specific deficiencies and offer actionable suggestions to strengthen the work.

principles.title: COPE Ethical Alignment
principles.subtitle: Integrity Compliance
principles.description: Assessments strictly comply with Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) Ethical Guidelines for Peer Reviewers, upholding transparency, rigor, and mutual respect.

lifecycle.label: Review Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: 5-stage review workflow: heading, intro, double-blind note and stage cards
lifecycle.title: The 5-Stage Review Lifecycle
lifecycle.subtitle: REVIEW WORKFLOW
lifecycle.content: A structured, timed workflow ensures unbiased peer appraisal while maintaining predictable turnaround times for authors and editors.

meta.guaranteeText: Reviewers never see author names, affiliations, or acknowledgements. Author copy excludes all reviewer identities.

stages.title: Invitation & Abstract Assessment
stages.text: The Section Editor sends an invitation with the anonymized title, abstract, and review deadline. The reviewer decides whether the topic fits their core expertise.

stages.title: Conflict & Commitment Declaration
stages.text: The reviewer accepts the invitation online, certifying zero conflict of interest and committing to the agreed review deadline.

stages.title: Double-Blind Manuscript Appraisal
stages.text: The full anonymized manuscript and supplementary datasets become accessible through the secure portal for thorough analysis.

stages.title: Structured Rubric & Recommendations
stages.text: The reviewer scores the 5 criteria, provides confidential comments to the editor, and submits itemized constructive feedback for the authors.

stages.title: Editorial Synthesis & Certificate
stages.text: The Editor-in-Chief synthesizes referee reports to render the editorial verdict (Accept, Minor/Major Revision, or Reject) and issues an official Reviewer Certificate.

rubric.label: Evaluation Rubric
rubric.description: Five assessment dimensions: heading, scorecard header, table columns, criteria rows and footnote. Tick 'ethical' for pass/fail rows.
rubric.title: Five Structured Assessment Dimensions
rubric.subtitle: EVALUATION RUBRIC
rubric.content: Each manuscript is rated across five standardized criteria accompanied by itemized written feedback and recommendations.

meta.scorecardDescription: Standardized double-blind evaluation matrix across five weighted dimensions.

criteria.focus: Does the manuscript present novel empirical findings, innovative theoretical insights, or a valuable critical synthesis that significantly advances the disciplinary state-of-the-art?
Are experimental protocols, sampling criteria, statistical analyses, and reproducibility documentation sound, robust, and appropriately controlled against international benchmarks?
Are institutional ethical approvals (IRB / Animal Welfare), informed consent protocols, conflict of interest declarations, and funding disclosures fully verified and documented?
Is contemporary peer-reviewed literature comprehensively integrated, accurately cited, and fairly synthesized without selective omissions or biased historiography?
Are figures, tables, supplementary data sets, and analytical arguments formatted clearly, logically organized, and written in concise academic English?

meta.footnote: **Threshold for Recommendation:** Aggregate minimum score of 18/25 points with an unconditional Ethical Clearance.

recognition.label: Recognition
recognition.description: Reviewer accreditation and community benefits: heading, intro and benefit cards
recognition.title: Reviewer Accreditation & Community Benefits
recognition.subtitle: SCHOLARLY RECOGNITION
recognition.content: We value the time and expertise of our reviewers with verifiable credentials, annual public acknowledgement, and a path to editorial roles.

benefits.title: Official Reviewer Certificate
benefits.description: Every completed peer review is authenticated with an official, verifiable digital certificate issued by the Gono Bishwabidyalay Editorial Secretariat.

benefits.title: Editorial Board Progression
benefits.description: Outstanding and consistently punctual reviewers are given first consideration for appointment as Section Editors and Editorial Board members.

benefits.title: Annual Index Acknowledgement
benefits.description: Reviewers are publicly acknowledged in the annual journal index volume and on the journal’s permanent academic registry portal.

cta.label: Closing CTA
cta.description: Reviewer recruitment band (badge, heading, eligibility pills, two buttons) and the editorial secretariat contact card
cta.title: Apply to Join Our Expert Referee Network
cta.subtitle: JOIN THE REVIEWER PANEL
cta.content: We welcome qualified researchers holding a doctoral degree (PhD), clinical fellowship, or senior academic rank with an active publication record in health, pharmacy, agriculture, law, computing, or social sciences.

meta.contactText: Need assistance with manuscript access, rubric scoring, or timeline extension requests? Reach our editorial team directly.
